_comment: Human-in-the-loop curation layer for the research agent. fetch.py auto-discovers repos; this file keeps quality high: drop off-lineage noise (exclude), fix categories/descriptions (overrides), and set the inclusion floor (min_stars). Editing this file is the main way contributors shape the list.

categories.title: Implementations & apps
categories.blurb: Standalone apps and web tools that compile your sources into a maintained wiki.

categories.title: Agent skills & CLI plugins
categories.blurb: Drop-in skills/plugins that turn Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Copilot into a wiki maintainer.

categories.title: Obsidian & vault-based
categories.blurb: Implementations that live inside an Obsidian vault or a plain Markdown folder.

categories.title: Local-first & offline
categories.blurb: Runs against local models (Ollama et al.) so raw sources never leave your machine.

categories.title: Knowledge graph & database variants
categories.blurb: Push past flat Markdown into typed entities, graphs, and queryable databases.

categories.title: Capture & ingestion
categories.blurb: Clippers and importers that feed raw sources into a wiki.

nashsu/llm_wiki.description: The flagship desktop app. Knowledge graph (Louvain communities, Adamic-Adar), optional LanceDB vector search, Deep Research, human review of contradictions/duplicates, Chrome clipper, local MCP server.

lucasastorian/llmwiki.description: Open-source implementation that connects your Claude account via MCP and has the agent write the wiki on a nightly routine. Deliberately small tool surface (search/read/create/edit/append/lint).

Astro-Han/karpathy-llm-wiki.description: Agent-Skills-compatible LLM wiki that drops into Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain.description: Evolution of the pattern from append-only to rewrite: existing pages are updated in place, contradictions reconcile automatically — a vault that rewrites itself.

kytmanov/obsidian-llm-wiki-local.description: Karpathy's LLM Wiki, 100% local with Ollama. Drop Markdown notes, the agent extracts and interlinks.

dimknaf/braindb.description: An LLM Wiki upgraded into a real database: typed entities and graph relations instead of plain Markdown.

SyncNos/SyncNos-Webclipper.description: Web clipper that saves AI chats, web articles, and video transcripts straight into an LLM-wiki-style vault.

sdyckjq-lab/llm-wiki-skill.description: A multi-platform personal-knowledge-base skill built on Karpathy's LLM Wiki methodology.

cclank/Hermes-Wiki.description: An LLM Wiki built on top of the Hermes agent, with full source included.

iBlinkQ/llm-wiki-obsidian-blink.description: An Obsidian implementation of Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

gatelynch/llm-knowledge-base.description: A personal KB that explicitly layers raw material, LLM-compiled knowledge, in-progress thinking, and final outputs — based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki.

mduongvandinh/llm-wiki.description: A fully automated personal knowledge-base system following the LLM Wiki pattern.

luotwo/llm-wiki.description: Build a continuously-accumulating personal knowledge base with an LLM; ships a Claude Code Skill.

selmakcby/knowledge-pipeline.description: A terminal-style pipeline + LLM-Wiki skill that turns raw chats into a structured knowledge base.

liangdabiao/llm-wiki.description: Continuously build and maintain a personal KB with AI; ingests web, Twitter, WeChat, Zhihu, YouTube, PDF and local files into a structured wiki, published as a static site via Quartz.

helloianneo/obsidian-ai-second-brain.description: A complete 4-phase, 12-step guide to building a personal KB with Obsidian + Claude, based on the LLM Wiki methodology.

SherwinQ/karpathy-wiki.description: An Agent Skill for building a knowledge base based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

Lambenthan/empiricalwiki.description: An AI knowledge base for empirical economics research — from literature reading to Stata execution — using Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea with 10 domain-specific entity types.
